policy.privacy_intro_p1: Welcome to Da-Costa. We dey committed to protecting your privacy while providing elite cybersecurity protection. This policy outlines our "Privacy-First" approach to data processing, specifically for our Unified Security Service Edge (SSE) features.
policy.privacy_email_p1: "Di Da-Costa App provides real-time protection against Business Email Compromise (BEC) and social engineering through our 'Email Tone & Impersonation Analyzer.'"
policy.privacy_email_processing_p1: To detect impersonation, di app dey analyze di vocabulary, syntax, and tone of incoming emails. This analysis dey be performed using Stateless AI.
policy.privacy_email_retention_p1: We no dey store di body of your emails. Di app only caches a 'Tone Signature' (a mathematical representation of a sender's style) locally on your device to compare against future incoming messages.
policy.privacy_email_storage_p1: Your email content no dey ever be uploaded to our servers. E dey be processed in a transient state to generate a security risk score and is purged immediately after di scan.
policy.privacy_email_control_p1: You fit disconnect email monitoring or purge your local 'Tone Signature' cache at any time through di Data & Privacy settings.
policy.privacy_guarantee1_desc: We no dey ever sell your data to third parties.
policy.privacy_guarantee2_desc: Your security data no dey ever be used for advertising.
policy.privacy_guarantee3_desc: We no dey track your movements or app usage for analytics.
policy.privacy_guarantee4_desc: Personal messages and media no dey ever be stored in di cloud.
policy.privacy_rights_p1: Under GDPR, NDPR, and CCPA, you get full sovereignty over your data. You may export your audit logs, request immediate erasure, or revoke all background permissions directly from di app dashboard.
